```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse) # for ggplot2, dplyr, readr etc
library(here)      # for help finding files
library(gt)        # for tables
library(utils)     # to read tables
library(plotly)    # for interative plots
library(lme4)      # for linear mixed-effects model
library(performance) # to check models
library(emmeans)   # emmeans for estimated values
```

# Data loading

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
source(here("script/clean_data.R"))
```

# Theme graphics

```{r}
#| label: load-theme
#| message: false
#| 
thm<-theme(text = element_text(colour = "black",size =12),
           axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "black", size=12),
           axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black",size =12),
           legend.text = element_text(size=10),
           panel.grid = element_line(color="grey"),
           panel.background = element_rect(color="black", fill="white"),
           plot.caption = element_text(hjust=0),
           axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

col_treat=c("#3E3E3E", "#9BC3D9", "#53A48F", "#C58D5D")
```

# Models

## Leaf Nitrogen predicted values

### Model function

```{r}
#| label: run a linear regression
fit_model <- function(data, response, pred1, pred2,
                      random = "(1|block/plot/subplot/leaf)",
                      REML = FALSE) {
  formula_txt <- paste0(response, " ~ ", pred1, " * ", pred2, " + ", random)
  mod <- lmer(as.formula(formula_txt), data = data, REML = REML)
  mod
}
```

### Linear mixed-effects model

```{r}
#| label: model
lme_n <- fit_model(df, response = "n_corr", pred1 = "treatment", pred2 = "sp")
summary(lme_n)
anova(lme_n)
```

### Model checking

```{r}
#| label: model check
qqnorm(resid(lme_n))
```

### Predicted values extraction from the model

```{r}
#| label: extract predicted values
# Extract estimated values
means_data_n <- as.data.frame(emmeans(lme_n, 
                                      specs = c("treatment", "sp"),
                                      regrid ="response"))

# Extract predicted values into the dataframe
df$predicted_n <- predict(lme_n, df)
```

# Make a figure

### Effect of the treatments on the leaf nitrogen content (%dwt)

```{r}
#| label: figure 1. Leaf N content ~ treatment 
p1 <- ggplot(means_data_n, 
              aes(x = treatment, fill=treatment)) +
    geom_violin(data = df, aes(x = treatment, y = predicted_n), 
                alpha = 0.5, 
                linewidth = 0.8, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    facet_wrap(sp~., 
               labeller = labeller(sp = c("A"="Alopecurus borealis", "B"="Bistorta vivipara","S"="Salix polaris")), 
               scale="free_y")+ 
        scale_fill_manual(values = col_treat, 
                          labels = c("Control", "Icing", "Icing/Warming", "Warming"))+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), 
                  col="black", 
                  width = 0.15, 
                  size = 0.65, 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = emmean), 
               size = 3, 
               shape = 18, 
               col="black", 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control", "Icing", "Icing/\nWarming", "Warming")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Leaf [N] content (%dwt)", fill="Treatment") +
   thm+
   theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
         panel.grid = element_blank(),
         strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
         strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", color = "black", size = 12), 
         axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
ggplotly(p1)
```
